groups.title: WebKit tabs save your passwords
new: WebKit tabs offer to save the passwords you type and fill your saved logins for that site, the same way Firefox tabs do.
improved: WebKit tabs come back when you restore a session, sleep and wake like other tabs, and recover from crashes.
WebKit tabs use Firefox's error pages, prompts, and Save dialog.
New windows open faster: Whimsy sets up menus, panels, and stylesheets the first time you use them instead of at launch.
Settings opens faster, since each section is built the first time you visit it.
Whimsy Home appears sooner and is ready ahead of time when you open a new tab.
Reading text in images and indexing pages for Related happen in idle time, so browsing stays smooth.
fixed: Tab search finds other tabs on the same page as the one you're on.
Hover cards for background tabs no longer get stuck waiting.
After a WebKit page loads, the address bar shows its address.
A broken default setting no longer causes an error at every launch.

groups.title: Folder tabs come back where you left them
improved: The Extension Builder and chat can use your connectors' tools with OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama, not only Claude. Tools that change something still ask you first.
Related finds pages that belong together more reliably, including long pages.
fixed: Unloading a folder keeps each tab on the page you were last on, instead of resetting it to the page it was pinned on.
Shadows stay dark in adaptive dark instead of turning into light halos around cards.
The Extension Builder can write its plugin when you use Claude with an API key.
Asking chat to fill a form and then send it submits the form.
When translating with AI fails, Firefox's own translation takes over, and if that also fails you see why.
Ollama models that can't use tools keep answering when connectors are on.

groups.title: Emoji keep their colors in dark pages
improved: Adaptive dark recolors canvases as they draw, so charts and canvas text go dark while photos keep their colors.
fixed: Emoji keep their colors in adaptive dark, whether a page draws them as text, images, backgrounds, SVG, or on a canvas.
Quitting while Whimsy is reading text in an image no longer makes it hang.
Reading text in images works on macOS 27.0.1.

groups.title: AppleScript, an extension builder, and protected video in WebKit
new: Whimsy has an AppleScript dictionary for its windows, tabs, and spaces, and it never shows private windows or tabs.
Chat can write a local extension for you, with a card to review it and run it.
Open as Popover floats any tab in place as a Mini Window.
Save Image As on an SVG saves it as SVG, PNG, or JPG.
A page that asks for protected video switches its tab to WebKit, so streaming sites can play.
Chat's Add menu can attach a space or a folder.
improved: Moving a tab between Firefox and WebKit brings the site's cookies along, so you stay signed in.
WebKit tabs are no longer dimmed or tinted by the window's backdrop.
Hover cards skip in-page links, show a picture only when a page has a real preview image, and skip summaries of boilerplate pages.
Related rows in ⌘K leave out thin landing pages, and the Ask row is spaced like the search row.
With the agent on, chat hands requests to act to the agent and answers everything else itself.
Plugin cards list every site a plugin asks for.
fixed: Video controls stay on their video while the page scrolls.
A tab expanded from Glance in a space with no other tabs stays a regular tab, so Ctrl+Tab and switching spaces can return to it.
WebKit tabs keep their title, icon, and loading state after switching engines.
Rows with icons come first in each section of the tab menu.
An answer still streaming when you close chat is saved, so reopening chat shows it.
An agent task that hits an error ends instead of staying in progress.
Whimsy works with Zen 1.24.3b.

groups.title: Site Settings shows every row again
fixed: Site Settings in the site panel shows Tracking Protection, Zoom, Autoplay, and the rest again, beneath the Engine row.

groups.title: A pen, WebKit tabs, and tasks in ⌘K
new: Draw on Page puts a freehand pen on any page, and your drawings are listed in the page panel.
Open in WebKit moves a tab or site into macOS WebKit, and Open in Firefox moves it back.
Run a task commands ask for their blanks in ⌘K, then plan the task right there.
Take over on the ⌘K status card hands you the tab while the agent drives, and Continue gives it back.
When the agent reaches a sign-in form, it fills your saved login for that site first.
improved: Change This Page can rearrange a page into grids, columns, and rows, and a kept change stays with the profile you made it in.
Reset All Tabs in This Space can be undone, and Undo puts each tab back on the page it was showing.
Downloads always keeps a shortcut, and a shortcut that can't be set names what it conflicts with.
fixed: Hover cards and Spaces Sync open only web pages, and signed-in tabs you hover are never sent to a cloud model.
Replay hides codes and passwords typed into plain text fields.
Easel's front and back keys match the bracket keys on your keyboard.

groups.title: Clean links and steady pages
fixed: Copy URL copies only the clean link, so it pastes the same in Docs, Slack, Notion, and plain text fields.
Clicking in apps like FigJam, which change their address or open a popup, no longer flips the page between light and dark.

groups.title: Links that open Whimsy
new: whimsy:// links can switch Spaces, run a search, and run a short list of safe commands, so a note or another app can send you straight there.
improved: Dark pages stay dark: Whimsy judges a page while it loads, when its address changes, and when it changes its own theme.
fixed: A panel or expanded results opening over a page no longer flips it between light and dark.
Renaming a tab no longer shows a toast.

groups.title: Mini Whimsy from any app
new: Press ⌥Space in any app to open Mini Whimsy’s command bar. Turn it on and pick another shortcut in Settings › Look and Feel, or say yes during onboarding.
improved: Chat as a popover docks on chat’s own side, has a Minimize button, and closes with ⌘W when it’s focused.
fixed: Switching chat between the sidebar and a popover keeps it open.

groups.title: Dark pages that stay dark
fixed: Expanding a Glance opened from a pinned tab, a folder, or an Essential gives a normal tab in the current space.
Auto dark mode leaves dark sites dark when a light popup, like a search box's suggestions, is open.
Sites that are dark through their own color scheme aren't turned grey.
Emoji drawn as images keep their colours in auto dark mode.

groups.title: A sidebar that stays put
improved: Links from other apps follow your Space Routing rules before opening in Mini Whimsy or Glance.
Searching Routing in the command bar finds Air Traffic Control.
View Downloads in the command bar opens the Library on Downloads.
Video seek buttons use Picture-in-Picture's skip arrow, with 10 on it.
fixed: After ⌘S, the sidebar stays hidden while your pointer rests at the edge; push to the edge or leave the window to bring it back.
Drafts keep and restore text typed into rich editors, like LinkedIn and X posts.
Analytics requests no longer count as a page saving what you typed, so drafts aren't thrown away.
GitHub live folders show new pull requests and issues, and Refresh always fetches.
Glance's side buttons stay readable in any space color.
Private tabs stay private after a focus session ends.

groups.title: A way back from Expand
improved: Shrink an expanded Essential back into its popover by clicking its tile, pressing ⌘W, or choosing Open in Side Panel.
An Essential you shrank opens in its popover again next time, not full window.
Tab numbers and command bar numbers share one keycap that fades in and out, and rows no longer shift when the numbers appear.
In a Mini window, ⌘L floats the command bar right away.
fixed: Holding Command shows tab numbers again after you open and close the command bar.
⌘W only shrinks an Essential you expanded; otherwise it closes the tab as usual.
The changelog lists builds newest first.

groups.title: Essentials float like picture-in-picture
new: An Essential’s popover has Expand, which fills the window with the site, and Minimize, which tucks it back into its tile while it keeps running.
Drag a popover by its top bar to move it anywhere over the page; each site remembers where you left it.
Resize a popover from any edge or corner; double-click an edge to put it back beside the sidebar at its usual size.
improved: A popover stays open while you use the page behind it and when you switch tabs.
⌘W closes whichever has focus: the popover if you’re in it, otherwise the tab behind it.
fixed: Opening a Glance from an Essential’s popover no longer makes every Essential open as a normal tab afterwards.

groups.title: Several AI accounts and usage rings
new: Connect more than one Claude or ChatGPT account in Settings > AI, each with its own sign-in and an editable label like Work or Personal.
When one account runs out, Whimsy moves on to the next account in your list before an answer starts.
improved: A ring beside each plan account shows how much of its limit is used; click it to see 5-hour and weekly usage and when they reset.
Claude accounts show your plan name, such as Max or Pro.
The changelog lists every Dev build.
fixed: Holding Command in the command bar shows each row’s number, like ⌘1 and ⌘2, instead of an empty badge.
Holding Command shows tab numbers in the sidebar’s text colour again.
The Edit Field button fades on hover instead of flashing white.
Open, Remind me, and Dismiss are readable on a selected Updates row, in light and dark.

groups.title: Gmail and Drive search
new: Search Gmail and Google Drive from the command bar across accounts connected in Settings > AI.

groups.title: Local plugins and command ranking
improved: Local plugins show their permissions before you choose Run or Don’t Run, with Open Plugins Folder in Settings > Privacy & Security.
Local plugins support older and newer extension formats and appear in open Add-ons lists after a rescan.
The command bar keeps commands in a consistent order and shows extensions available in the current space.
Cookie banner blocking dismisses more unrecognized banners without giving consent.
Tab numbers, link hints, and the Edit Field button share clearer key badges.

groups.title: Richer Reader and AI usage
improved: Reader View includes tables, infoboxes, math, figures, and references while keeping wide content inside the article.
Edit Text on Page offers a floating bar with Save and Cancel to keep or undo all your edits.
AI providers show reported usage and reset times in Settings > AI, with clearer messages when a limit is reached.
Adaptive Dark Mode in the site panel shows the current result and lets you restore the profile’s choice.
The Focus session timer has a rounded appearance and smoother animation.
fixed: Extensions hidden in the current space stay out of the command bar.
Cmd+click on a folder item opens a normal tab.

groups.title: Dark mode and recent tabs
fixed: Site dark mode changes apply immediately, with controls that stay steady while toggling.
A Glance expanded into its own tab appears in Ctrl+Tab’s recent tabs.

groups.title: Focus, passkeys, and page tools
new: Focus sessions: start a timer from the command bar, pause distracting sites, and stay on one tab, with site choices in Settings > General.
Save Touch ID passkeys and verification codes, with controls in Settings > Privacy & Security.
Automatic dark mode uses a site’s own theme when available, with a switch in the site panel.
Highlight passages in four colors and add a page note from the right-click menu or command bar.
Keep adult sites out of history with a switch in Settings > Privacy & Security.
Choose which photo details to remove before uploads, drops, and pastes in Settings > Privacy & Security.
Safety Check in Settings > Privacy & Security reviews updates, breached passwords, risky extensions, and unused site permissions.
Local plugins: load extensions from your profile’s plugin folder after reviewing and approving them in Settings > Privacy & Security.
Play rain, cafe, woods, fireplace, ocean, or brown noise from the command bar.
Show Page Minimap in the command bar adds a live page overview you can click or drag to scroll.
Pass Keys to Page in the command bar gives a site your browser shortcuts until you hold Esc or leave the tab.
Edit Field in Text Editor opens the focused field in your Mac’s editor and brings your changes back.
improved: The tab volume panel offers an eight-band equalizer with presets saved per site.
Space themes can match the current page with Blend, Gradient, or Replace, and Settings > Look and Feel offers Lucide and Phosphor icon packs.
The site panel separates Profile Settings from Site Settings, with permissions, dark mode, and zoom kept per profile.
Choose which profiles receive an extension when installing it, and find extension buttons in the site panel.
Chat can attach a page and the tabs opened from it as one context group, with a tab badge while AI reads.
The command bar offers Quiz Me on This Page, and Settings > AI lets you choose how AI writes and its preferred language.
AI finds relevant passages in long pages and transcripts, and agents can save a tab as a PDF after approval.
Call Options can share the current tab, call Picture-in-Picture follows other speakers, and Granola notes follow calls outside your calendar.
Essentials open in resizable popovers, and Show Chat as Popover is available from the command bar.
The empty command bar includes Recently Closed and Synced Tabs, and holding Command reveals tab numbers.
Tab and page menus put common actions first, with Search With for selected text and New Private Tab in the sidebar’s plus menu.
Settings offers space names in window titles, pop-ups as tabs, dimming inactive windows, and a second Esc press to leave full screen.
fixed: Extension-opened tabs and windows stay in the space and profile that opened them.
A Private Space stays open when another synced window is not showing it.
Link hover cards let the page scroll, zoom, and receive clicks normally, and close when you leave the link.
The loading indicator stays visible when you switch to a background tab that is still loading.
Holding Cmd+K listens only while the keys are held, and a tap no longer starts listening.
The command bar keeps the last letters typed while it fades after Enter and hides actions that cannot run on the current page.
AI permission prompts appear in the front window, with pending requests available in Settings.
Cmd+S keeps the sidebar closed while the pointer rests on its edge.
Splitting a pinned tab with Shift+click leaves its folder collapsed.
Tidy titles keeps live folder tabs on their page titles.
VPN calls try the protected connection before offering to pause the VPN.
Downloads deleted from the Library move to the Trash.

groups.title: AI chat, agents, and routines
new: Chat: press Cmd+E to talk about a page, with separate conversations for each tab.
Attach tabs to chat and inspect what AI sees before sending.
Ask AI directly from the command bar and continue the answer in chat.
Agent mode: review a plan and let Whimsy carry out a browser task.
Connect outside agents and review their actions in Activity.
Routines: schedule tasks or run them when you visit a site or return to the browser.
Updates in the command bar collect watch results and routine notifications, with reminders for later.
Connect apps through MCP in Settings and bring Granola context into chat.
Save reusable AI commands with prompts that include page or selected text.
Memory: let chat remember facts you share, with controls to inspect, edit, export, or delete them.
Related results find previously visited pages by meaning.
Summarize pages and PDFs with links back to the passages used.
Summarize videos with chapter links, transcripts, and key quotes.
Draft replies and fill visible form fields with AI, with Undo for written replies.
Describe changes to a page and keep its edited appearance.
Translate pages with AI while keeping their links.
Get scam warnings before entering sensitive details on unfamiliar sites.
Compare products by their true price from the address bar.
Hold Fn to dictate, or hold Cmd+K to speak a command.
Select, copy, find, and translate text inside images.
Listen to pages with macOS voices and sentence highlighting.
Type : in the command bar to find and insert an emoji.
improved: AI settings bring providers, models, permissions, and feature controls onto one page.
Chat answers include citations, tables, and research reports you can open in a tab.
Link previews can show a short AI summary.
Hover over the chat dock edge to peek at a conversation.
Expand memory chips to see facts used or saved, and remove saved facts in place.
The command bar finds open tabs across spaces and profiles, labeled with their space.
Fire lets you choose spaces, data types, and time ranges, including chats and agent activity.
Video speed ranges from 1/16× to 16×, with a button to return to your default.
Find can open as a floating card with an option to ask AI about the page.
Agents ask before visiting new sites, sending forms, or using connector tools that make changes.
Agents reuse open tabs and check whether a task succeeded before reporting completion.
Cookie banner blocking uses updated rules.
fixed: Chat memory skips invented and repeated facts.
Chat suggestion chips send their question when clicked.
Mouse back and forward buttons work at the Library edge.
Tab status text fits within its row.
Read aloud buttons stay clickable as their controls expand.
Typing in sidebar fields no longer triggers tab navigation or deletion.
Tidy Tabs leaves agent task folders intact.
Library sections keep their order when turned off and back on.
Pages scroll normally beneath an open link preview.

groups.title: Easel, form drafts, and site controls
new: Easel: arrange live page captures and shapes on a canvas, kept separately for each profile.
Form drafts: restore what you typed after reloading or reopening a tab.
This Site controls remember zoom, autoplay, Reader View, full screen, and user agent choices.
Battery Saver reduces background activity, with automatic and manual controls.
Inspect fonts, colors, contrast, spacing, and what a page is built with.
Open a private command bar with Cmd+Option+T.
Hide spaces and bring them back from Show Hidden Spaces.
Choose whether private tabs and locked spaces lock as soon as you leave them.
Call Options let microphone and camera buttons mute the call or block the device.
Live captions work for calls, including in Picture-in-Picture.
Pause the VPN for a call and restore its site rule when the call ends.
Connect OpenAI or Gemini with an API key, or sign in with a ChatGPT or Claude plan.
View Source has a line wrap option.
improved: Ctrl+Tab shows recent tabs across spaces, with space labels and faster opening for large tab collections.
Mini Whimsy supports multiple page tabs and a searchable Open in Space list.
Quick Notes save as you type and keep notes for the current page easy to find.
Library Screenshots uses a thumbnail grid with adjustable sizes.
Screenshots offer portrait capture, blur, and redaction after capture.
The shortcut cheat sheet is searchable, and floating panels have draggable headers.
Settings search highlights matching rows and lets Return step through results.
Menu settings show submenus in place and use the menus’ own names.
Toasts stack without covering one another and offer clearer actions and Undo.
Option+drag a link lasso to open its links as tabs or make a folder.
Live folders offer Resync to restore tabs you closed by hand.
VPN location and site rules are available from the address bar.
Reader View keeps reading time, sharing, and saved page zoom.
Press a shortcut again to run the browser command when a page uses the first press.
Essential tabs have their own unread badge switch.
Balloon Dash keeps running when you reconnect until you choose Reload.
Shift+Enter opens the top search result directly, with Search Deck available as an option.
Toasts no longer pause for macOS Focus modes.
fixed: Reopening a pinned tab or Essential restores the page you left and its back history.
Private command bar suggestions stay separate from normal browsing.
Ctrl+Tab keeps private and normal tabs apart.
Locked tabs require unlocking before they can be moved, copied, or shared.
Hidden spaces stay out of swipes and move menus.
Tabs moved between profiles keep their isolation and select the reopened page.
Sign-in and extension popups work in Mini Whimsy.
Mini Whimsy stays at the normal window level.
Pasted screenshots upload once through the page’s own upload controls.
Call controls follow your microphone and camera without affecting other participants.
Cmd+T starts with an empty command bar, even after a quick close and reopen.
Screenshots open centered, save once, and accept Enter to capture or Esc to cancel.
Split layout shortcuts no longer pull in an extra Essential.
Previously visited intranet addresses open as addresses instead of searches.
Notes and Easel live blocks load sites with stricter sign-in protections.
Per-profile download folders work correctly.
Private screenshots stay out of the Library.
Fire and history clearing also remove matching archived and snoozed tabs.

groups.title: Live captions, menus and focus
new: Live captions: on-device speech-to-text for videos that lack captions.
Menus settings: turn individual right-click menu items on or off.
Focus integration: Whimsy toasts pause while a macOS Focus mode is on.
Paste guard: warns before pasting secrets or sensitive tokens into web pages.
Cast web video directly to AirPlay receivers from the View menu.
Local network discovery: Bonjour finds local development servers automatically.
Split View headers: each pane has a header menu to separate, swap, or close panes.
Redact tool: black out sensitive text or images before capturing screenshots.
Teach once: helpful hints the first time a shortcut can help you.
Turn the Private Space into a permanent space with the New Space dialog.
improved: Fire button offers simpler choices to Fire in This Profile or Fire Everywhere.
Linear live folders work with your signed-in session without an API key.
Portrait captures take mobile-sized screenshots of any page.
Changelog dev build IDs show only on the Dev update channel.
fixed: Split view restored layouts cleanly reconnect without closing sibling panes.
Quick window address fields keep controls centered and clear of traffic lights.

groups.title: Profiles, link hints and audio controls
new: Profiles: separate your personal, work, and school browsing with isolated logins, passwords, history, and extensions.
Audio indicator on tabs: see which tab is playing sound, with one-click mute.
Link hints: press Cmd+J to show letter badges on links and click them from the keyboard.
Zap: press Cmd+Shift+X to erase distracting banners or overlays from any page.
Instant result: press Shift+Enter in the command bar to open the top search result immediately.
Search Deck: flip through search results side-by-side in a Glance view.
Trails: branch back and forward through pages you navigated away from.
Page actions: address bar pill offering quick actions based on page data.
Copy as Markdown and view .md and .csv files directly in the browser.
Link lasso: Cmd+drag over links on a page to select and open them together.
Generate QR codes for any webpage from the context menu.
improved: Already-open tabs: entering an open tab's URL in the command bar switches straight to it.
Unified Settings: cleaner navigation combining Appearance and Tab Management without lost options.
Linear and Jira live folders let you customize which issue statuses are shown.
fixed: Mini Whimsy controls sit flush in the address strip and traffic lights no longer flicker.
Essentials and pinned tabs drop extraneous borders and place unread badges on the tile corner.

groups.title: AI, seasonal touches and email aliases
new: AI features: ask questions about the current page, preview pages in 5 seconds, and watch pages for changes.
Seasonal touches: dynamic seasonal gradients on tab loading and festive balloon costumes.
Email aliases: generate Firefox Relay and iCloud Hide My Email addresses in form fields.
Handoff: pick up your active web page on your iPhone or other Apple devices.
Offline Playlist: queue up video files to watch offline.
Liquid Glass effect for translucent sidebars and toolbars.
improved: Tidy tabs cleans up verbose page titles when you pin a tab.
Library rail icons animate smoothly when clicked.
Reduced motion support across animations, balloons, and page decor.
Enhanced privacy protections for background readers and AI previews.

groups.title: Mini Whimsy, calendar and history
new: Mini Whimsy: lightweight floating windows for external links, with easy space switching.
Space-aware History: see which space you visited each page in, and filter History by space.
Next Meeting: see your upcoming calendar events in the sidebar and join calls with one click.
Whimsy homepage (about:whimsy) with quick links, keyboard shortcuts, and Arc import.
This changelog, showing every build's updates in one place.
Connect Claude: interact with your tabs using a private, token-free connection.
Per-space VPN: protect your connection across your whole browser or only in selected spaces.
Balloon Dash: an arcade mini-game when you're offline or waiting for a page to load.
Recent tabs in the command bar, plus offline search bangs.
Adjust Glance sizes to Compact, Standard, or Wide.
People cards: preview GitHub, LinkedIn, and X profiles by hovering over links.
improved: Custom space icons featuring the full set of colorful glyphs.
Video speed controller: click the speed badge on any video to pick or type any playback speed.
Manage which extensions run in each space.
Tree tabs let you drag tabs to reparent them or collapse entire tab branches.

groups.title: Splits, tabs and library
new: Open links in a side-by-side Split View, swap panes, or expand a pane to take the whole window.
Quick windows: open links from other apps in a focused window without cluttering your spaces.
Archive tabs automatically after 12 or 24 hours, and restore closed tabs with Cmd+Z.
Snooze tabs until later today, tomorrow, or a custom time.
Lock spaces with Touch ID or your system password.
Library sections for Notes, Downloads, Finder folders, Screenshots, and Archive.
A Private Space for quick private browsing, and private tabs.
Fire button to quickly close tabs and wipe recent browsing data.
System menu bar item to quickly jump to open tabs and spaces.
improved: Tree style tab grouping with collapsible branches.
Clean print mode that removes site clutter before printing.
Heavy tab warnings when a page uses excessive CPU.

groups.title: Sound, video and reading
new: Mute background tabs, and remember sites you've muted.
Set a tab's volume and a video's playback speed.
Picture-in-picture opens when you leave a video and closes when you come back.
Take screenshots, edit a page's text, and copy and paste on sites that block it.
Find missing pages in the Internet Archive.
See information about any image.
Translate the text you've selected.
improved: Reader view lets you pick its typography and shows reading time.
PDFs can follow dark mode.
Find starts with the text you've selected.
Update settings now live in About Whimsy.

groups.title: Spaces, your way
new: Drop tabs on a space's icon to move them there.
Open a link in another space from the context menu.
Pick theme colors by hex value, with transparency, menu icons and your own interface font.
improved: Each space remembers the tab you were last on.
Search for a space's emoji, or hide the space switcher.

groups.title: Tidier tabs
new: Color your folders.
A thin line shows a page loading.
Pinned tabs and Essentials show unread counts and update dots.
Group tabs by site.
improved: The New Tab button can sit at the bottom of the sidebar.

groups.title: Links and privacy
new: Copy rich links, or links to several tabs at once.
Turn off the browser's AI features in Settings.
Duplicate a tab with Cmd+Shift+D, and pin or unpin it with Cmd+D.
improved: Tracking bits are removed from links, and cookie banners are declined, by default.
Private windows are easier to tell apart.
New tabs open below the current one, inside its folder.
Choose how tab titles wrap, and dim sleeping tabs.

groups.title: Hello, Whimsy
new: Arc-style Ctrl+Tab.
App icons to choose from.
Zoom the whole interface.
See your pull requests apart from your team's.
Automatic updates.
